name: mouse-state
description: Windows-only native addon with two small win32 helpers Electron has no JS API for: a GetAsyncKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) check (detects when a title-bar drag's mouse button is actually released — Chromium doesn't deliver a normal DOM mouseup for this kind of window drag), and a DwmSetWindowAttribute(DWMWA_WINDOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE) call (forces Windows 11's native rounded-corner clipping on Disc's frameless window, which opts itself out of it by default).
